# Environment

```{r}
# Packages
packages <- c("tidyverse", "ggalluvial", "cowplot", "scales", "ggtext")

# Load packages
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE))

# Print environment
set.seed(45)
Sys.info()
sessionInfo()

# Themes
source("./lib/consistent_themes.R")
source("./lib/processed_data_functions.R")

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, scipen = 999)

status_colors <- c(
  "Fully covered" = "#1B9E77",
  "Partially covered" = "#E6AB02",
  "Not covered" = "#D95F02"
)

gene_workflow_colors <- c(
  "All genes" = "#BDBDBD",
  "Covered" = "#2166AC",
  "Not covered" = "#B2182B",
  "Fully covered" = "#1B9E77",
  "Partially covered" = "#E6AB02"
)
```

# Load data

```{r data}
load_processed_data(
  "./data/probe_mapping/curated/probe_mapping_data.RDS",
  c(
    "reference_genome_summary", "gene_coverage", "bin_coverage",
    "gene_track_data", "bait_track_data", "partial_genes",
    "relative_gene_coverage", "amr_gene_summary",
    "amr_gene_segments", "reference_limit_mb"
  )
)
```

# Figure 2A: Coverage over genome

```{r figure-2a}
paste0(
  "Percentage of genome covered by a probe: ",
  round(reference_genome_summary$genome_covered_percent, 2)
)

p2A_coverage <- ggplot(
  bin_coverage,
  aes(midpoint_mb, coverage_percent)
) +
  geom_area(fill = "#9ECAE1") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, color = "#08519C") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgrey") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, reference_limit_mb), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 101),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    labels = label_number(suffix = "%")
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Probe coverage\nper 10 kb window") +
  theme_figure +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(3, 5, 0, 5)
  )

p2A_genes <- ggplot(gene_track_data) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 0,
    xmax = reference_limit_mb,
    ymin = 0.5,
    ymax = 1.5,
    fill = "white",
    color = "grey75"
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    aes(xmin = start_mb, xmax = end_mb, ymin = 0.5, ymax = 1.5),
    fill = "#B2182B",
    color = NA
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, reference_limit_mb), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 1.5), breaks = NULL, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Gene") +
  theme_figure +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 9),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 0, 5)
  )

p2A_baits <- ggplot(bait_track_data) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 0,
    xmax = reference_limit_mb,
    ymin = 0.5,
    ymax = 1.5,
    fill = "white",
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    aes(xmin = start_mb, xmax = end_mb, ymin = 0.5, ymax = 1.5),
    fill = "#2166AC",
    color = NA
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, reference_limit_mb),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(8)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 1.5), breaks = NULL, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Reference genome position (Mb)", y = "Probe coverage") +
  theme_figure +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 9),
    axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 3, 5)
  )

p2A <- plot_grid(
  p2A_coverage,
  p2A_genes,
  p2A_baits,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(3, 0.26, 0.52),
  align = "v",
  axis = "lr"
)

p2A
```

# Figure 2B: Gene coverage data

```{r figure-2b}
total_genes <- nrow(gene_coverage)
covered_genes <- sum(gene_coverage$covered_bp > 0L)
fully_covered_genes <- sum(gene_coverage$coverage_status == "Fully covered")
partially_covered_genes <- sum(gene_coverage$coverage_status == "Partially covered")
uncovered_genes <- sum(gene_coverage$coverage_status == "Not covered")

paste0("Percentage of genes covered by a probe: ",round(covered_genes/total_genes*100,2))

gene_stage_levels <- c("All genes", "Probe coverage", "Coverage completeness")
gene_stratum_levels <- c(
  "Not covered",
  "Partially covered",
  "Fully covered",
  "Covered",
  "All genes"
)

p2B <- ggplot(data=gene_coverage,aes(x=coverage_status)) + geom_bar(fill='black',width=0.66) + theme_bw() + labs(x="Level of probe coverage",y="Genes")  +
    geom_text(
        stat = "count", 
        aes(label = after_stat(count)), 
        vjust = -0.15,size = 3
    ) +ylim(NA,1775)

p2B
```

# Figure 2C: Partial coveregd genes distribution

```{r figure-2c}
partial_genes <- gene_coverage %>%
  filter(coverage_status == "Partially covered")

table(partial_genes$coverage_percent >=80)

p2C <- ggplot(partial_genes, aes(coverage_percent)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 2.5,
    boundary = 0,
    color = "white",
    fill = "black"
  ) +
  geom_rug(alpha = 0.25) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    labels = label_number(suffix = "%")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    x = "Percent covered by probes",
    y = "Partially covered genes"
  ) +
  theme_figure +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
  )

p2C
```

# Figure 2D: Relative position bins

```{r figure-2d}
p2D <- ggplot(
  relative_gene_coverage,
  aes(relative_position, coverage_percent)
) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.18,
    height = 0,
    size = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.25,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.68,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    fill = alpha("#9ECAE1", 0.55),
    color = "#08519C",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    labels = label_number(suffix = "%")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Relative position (% from start)",
    y = "Percent covered by probes"
  ) +
  theme_figure +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p2D
```

# Figure 2E: 

```{r figure-2e}
format_locus_md <- function(x) {
  is_rrna <- grepl("rRNA", x)
  out <- ifelse(is_rrna, x, paste0("*", x, "*"))        # italicize gene symbols
  out <- gsub("\\*bla ?TEM\\*", "*bla*<sub>TEM</sub>", out)  # blaTEM subscript
  out
}

p2E <- ggplot() +
  geom_tile(
    data = amr_gene_summary,
    aes(x = 50, y = locus),
    width = 100,
    height = 0.64,
    fill = "#E6E6E6",
    color = "grey75"
  ) +
  geom_tile(
    data = amr_gene_segments,
    aes(
      x = segment_midpoint,
      y = locus,
      width = segment_width
    ),
    height = 0.64,
    fill = "#2166AC"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = amr_gene_summary,
    aes(
      x = 103,
      y = locus,
      label = sprintf("%.1f%%", coverage_percent)
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
    labels = label_number(suffix = "%"),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = format_locus_md) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 112), clip = "off") +
  labs(
    x = "Relative position (% from start)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_figure +
  theme(
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y     = element_markdown(size = 9),  # was element_text(face="italic")
    plot.margin     = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

p2E
```

# Combine and save

```{r combine, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
figure_2_new_top <- plot_grid(
  p2A,
  ncol = 1,
  labels = "A",
  label_size = 14
)

figure_2_new_middle <- plot_grid(
  p2B,
  p2C, 
  nrow = 1,
  rel_widths = c(0.66, 1),
  labels = c("B", "C"),
  label_size = 14, vjust = 0.75
)

figure_2_new_bottom <- plot_grid(
  p2D,
  p2E,
  nrow = 1,
  rel_widths = c(0.66, 1),
  labels = c("D", "E"), vjust = 0.75
)

figure_2_new <- plot_grid(
  figure_2_new_top,
  figure_2_new_middle,
  figure_2_new_bottom,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(1, 0.75, 1)
)

figure_2_new
```

# Save the figure
```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = file.path("figures/figure_2_probe_set_reference_genome_coverage.png"),
  plot = figure_2_new,
  width = 10,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
```
